{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bank of the Core Plaza''' was a large public square situated at the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|financial heart]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant.]] The plaza served as a locus of galactic finance, principally as the headquarters of the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]].

==History==
In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the plaza hosted the inaugural ceremony for the [[All Planets Relief Fund]], one of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] pet projects that responded to petitions from worlds in peril for immediate funding that otherwise would be stalled in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] bureaucratic quagmire; the fund's central account was being contributed to by multiple Senate-member worlds in [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline vertex]]. A criminal [[heist]] of the vertex treasury was attempted in the closing moments of the plaza ceremony—as the treasury was being escorted under [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] to its designated Core Bank vault repository—by members of the [[Slams|Slam gang]], in collusion with galactic criminals [[Granta Omega]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]].<ref name="JQ:TFP">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>

The heist served as a diversion to the plaza of all [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Security]] personnel from Omega and Zan Arbor's true target of [[Attack on the Senate Building|assassination]]—Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, who was presiding over a full-Senate debate in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Galactic Senate Building]] on whether to bar the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] from further action on behalf of the Senate. Omega and Zan Arbor were the masterminds also of the debate itself, for it was the result of a petition that originated with Omega's early sponsor, [[Eeropha]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]] (his power-hungry eyes set now on the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Republic Chancery]]), and brought to fruition by Jedi-shamed<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref> [[Nuralee]] Senator [[Bog Divinian]] and Jedi-deposed<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> [[Romin]] dictator [[Roy Teda]]. The conspirators hoped to eliminate Jedi interference and Palpatine in a single day.<ref name="JQ:TFP" />

The Bank of the Core Plaza was also where [[Kal Skirata]] first met with the terrorist [[Perrive]] in a black ops [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|operation]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
